newsitem.title: USA: Celgene to study thalidomide use for sores.
newsitem.headline: Celgene to study thalidomide use for sores.

text.p: Celgene Corp said on Monday it plans to initiate a "definitive evaluation" of SYNOVIR, or thalidomide, for the treatment of aphthous ulcers, the mouth and esophageal sores prevalent in AIDS patients.
The purpose of the study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of several doses of thalidomide in relieving or causing remission of aphthous ulcers in the patients.
The company said it would enroll and evaluate 84 patients in multiple sites across the country.
Last month the company submitted a New Drug Application for the use of thalidomide in erythema nodosum leprosum, an inflammatory condition associated with leprosy.
